28 open-source Sony projects built by reverse engineering

Open-source projects that exist because someone reverse engineered Sony headphones, cameras, Xperia and Bravia. 12 of 28 had a commit in the last 12 months. Most-starred: OpenMemories-Tweak, SonyHeadphonesClient, homebridge-bravia-tvos, sony-pm-alt, furble.
